title: Network Architect
description:
**◆ Role Overview** 




  





 The Network Architect is the most versatile technical authority in the Solution Engineering team, covering the full spectrum of IP networking from ISP backbone design to enterprise SD\-WAN, NFV, SASE, and GPON/FTTH access deployments. This role is critical to the MSI business where integrated network solutions are central to large deal pursuits. The architect must combine CCIE\-level depth with the commercial acumen to shape multi\-vendor network proposals for carrier, enterprise, and government customers.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 🔹 Architect carrier\-grade IP/MPLS backbone, metro Ethernet, and service provider networks.
 



 🔹 Design enterprise routing and switching solutions leveraging BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS, EVPN\-VXLAN, and network automation.
 



 🔹 Lead SD\-WAN solution design using Cisco Viptela, VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet, and Nokia Nuage platforms.
 



 🔹 Architect SASE solutions including ZTNA, CASB, SWG, FWaaS, and Secure SD\-WAN.
 



 🔹 Design GPON/XGS\-PON and FTTH networks, including OLT/ONT sizing, OSP design, and BSS/OSS integration.
 



 🔹 Develop NFV/SDN architectures using OpenStack, Kubernetes, ONAP, and virtualized network functions.
 



 🔹 Create HLDs, LLDs, BOQs, migration strategies, and technical proposals.
 



 🔹 Conduct customer workshops, discovery sessions, PoCs, and executive\-level presentations.
 



 🔹 Collaborate with sales teams, OEMs, and customers to shape and win strategic opportunities.
 



  





 Technical Expertise
 



 ✅ IP/MPLS, Segment Routing (SR\-MPLS/SRv6\), Traffic Engineering
 



 ✅ Routing \& Switching – BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS, EVPN\-VXLAN
 



 ✅ SD\-WAN – Cisco, VMware, Fortinet, Nokia
 



 ✅ SASE – Zscaler, Prisma Access, Fortinet SASE
 



 ✅ GPON / FTTH – Huawei, Nokia, ZTE Platforms
 



 ✅ NFV / SDN – OpenStack, Kubernetes, ONAP
 



 ✅ Data Centre Networking \& Spine\-Leaf Architectures
 



 ✅ Network Automation – Python, Ansible, Terraform
 



  





 Educational Qualifications
 



 🎓 B.E./B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or related disciplines.
 



 🎓 BCA / MCA / M.Sc. (IT / Networks) candidates with strong relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
 



 🎓 M.Tech or MBA (Technology Management) will be an added advantage.
 



  





 📩
 **Interested candidates may send their updated resume to hr@kccl.tv**

title: Senior Architect
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Creo Homes Pvt Ltd is a leading architectural design and turnkey construction company based in Kochi, Kerala, focused on redefining luxury home living. The company brings together architects, engineers, interior designers, and skilled craftsmen to create personalized homes that reflect each client’s vision. Creo Homes manages the entire journey from concept to completion, offering architecture, construction, interiors, and landscaping under one roof. Every project is guided by a strong commitment to creativity, quality, ethics, and customer satisfaction. With plans to expand to 20 cities across India by 2035, Creo Homes aims to be one of the most trusted home design brands in the country.
 



  





  





**Role Description** 



* The Senior Architect will lead the design and delivery of high\-end residential projects, from initial concept development to final execution.
* This full\-time, on\-site role based in Ernakulam includes preparing and reviewing architectural drawings, coordinating design details, and ensuring adherence to building codes and standards.
* The role involves collaborating closely with clients to understand their needs, presenting design proposals, and integrating feedback into refined solutions.
* The Senior Architect will work with project managers, structural engineers, interior designers, and site teams to ensure seamless coordination across disciplines and timely project completion.
* Day\-to\-day responsibilities also include supervising junior architects, overseeing quality of design documentation, and supporting continuous improvement in design processes and project workflows.



  





**Requirements:** 




**B.Arch degree (COA registration preferred).** 




**Minimum 5 years of experience in residential architecture.** 




**Proficiency in AutoCAD.** 




**Strong communication, presentation, and project coordination skills.** 




**Knowledge of local building rules and permit procedures.** 




  





**Location: Candidates must be based in Kochi or willing to relocate before joining** 




  





**Male Candidates are preffered** 




**Candidates from Kerala region is preferred** 









**Benefits:** 




**Cell phone reimbursement** 




**Internet reimbursement** 




**Provident Fund** 




  





**Work Location: In person**
